snippet.title: KIRILMA: Helix Horizon - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4548940

There was a before…
and then, something left unfinished.

Something changed.
Not suddenly… but irreversibly.

Fragments remain.
Echoes of what once was… and what should never have happened.

KIRILMA: Helix Horizon is a story-driven game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and uncovering the truth behind a collapse.

More will be revealed soon.
